notes: GPUI VIEWS. The target UI framework is GPUI 0.2.2 (Zed's framework), not React, and you have no training knowledge of its exact API. Before writing, read: the finished panel crates as worked examples (rever-ui-menus for popups and modals closing on outside click, rever-ui-traffic, rever-ui-history: their src and examples/preview.rs show how views, listeners, hover, scrolling, text fields, theme, strings and previews are done here), every file in rever-ui-kit/src, and vendor/gpui/src/elements/*.rs plus vendor/gpui/examples/*.rs for exact method names. Port stores/profiles.ts as a struct with methods (same persistence key and JSON shape behind rever-ui-state's Storage trait), then the views implementing gpui::Render, reproducing layout, sizes, colors and behaviors: the onboarding modal (list of AI providers and agent CLIs with their detected status, API key fields with save, the use button, skip), the browser import modal (pick a browser and profile, import cookies, progress and result), the profile menu (list, create persistent or incognito profile, delete, new tab in profile, import entry points) and the proxy button with its popover (scheme, host, port, credentials, enable, apply to tab or open a proxied tab). Everything these do over IPC (`window.rev.*`: probing agents, saving API keys, listing browser profiles, importing cookies, setting a tab's proxy) goes behind one trait in this crate the host implements later; the preview supplies a fake that returns plausible data. Already ported logic to use as path dependencies: rever-ui-state (Storage, tabs with ProxyConfig, constants with the agent catalog), rever-agent (agent and login detection result types, if they fit), rever-ui-menus (popup menu). API key fields must not show the key after saving (same masking as the TSX). Colors and sizes come from src/renderer/src/styles.css (tokens in rever_ui_kit::theme::Theme; define a missing one locally and list it). User-facing strings go through `rever_ui_kit::i18n::Lang::t(key)` with the keys the TSX uses. Keep logic in plain functions with Korean-named unit tests; a file gets the `Port of` marker only when its behaviors are all there. Preview: fill examples/preview.rs so `cargo run -p rever-ui-setup --example preview_setup` shows the views (an environment variable may choose which one is open); capture with `scripts/capture-window.sh preview_setup /tmp/preview_setup.png`, read the PNG, compare with the TSX, fix what is off. Do not bring windows to the front, do not capture the screen any other way, do not run the `rever` app, and never run cargo without `-p` (other crates in the workspace are mid-edit).
